entities.name: Eroshia
entities.description: A magically advanced city-state on the far eastern coast of Otaria, later Karona's base of power.

entities.name: Karona
entities.description: A goddess whose first home on Dominaria was Eroshia; her return devastated the city and she later made it her base.

entities.name: Umbra
entities.description: One of three unmen who came to Eroshia seeking a spell book for human bodies.

entities.name: Sash
entities.description: An unman who received a human body from Akroma and was later given an honorable position in Eroshia.

entities.name: Waistcoat
entities.description: An unman who received a human body from Akroma and was later given an honorable position in Eroshia.

entities.name: Governor Dereg
entities.description: Eroshia's governor, whose harpsichord was stolen by the unmen.

entities.name: Akroma
entities.description: Gave Sash and Waistcoat human bodies.

entities.name: Elionoway
entities.description: A sage who returned to Eroshia with Sash, Waistcoat and his followers.

entities.name: Averru
entities.description: City where most Eroshians were killed.

events.summary: The unmen Umbra, Sash and Waistcoat come to Eroshia seeking a spell book, crash Governor Dereg's party, steal his harpsichord and become outlaws.
events.quote: After crashing a party of Governor Dereg 's, where they stole his prized harpsichord as a joke, they became outlaws

events.summary: Sash and Waistcoat return with Elionoway, are arrested, and are freed by Karona's arrival.
events.quote: the arrival of Karona ensured that Sash and Waistcoat were freed and given honorable positions in the city

events.summary: Karona's wandering leaves Eroshia in ruins, with hundreds trampled and thousands injured.
events.quote: From the Plains Gate to the harbor, Eroshia lay in ruins.

events.summary: When Karona leaves Dominaria taking all magic, the cable cars and Sea Colossus collapse.
events.quote: The cable cars and the Sea Colossus collapsed, and the street lights all winked out.

events.summary: Karona returns, makes Eroshia her base, forcibly recruits its people as her army and kills the 300 who refuse.
events.quote: She forcefully recruited the city's population as her army, minus 300 who refused, whom she killed.

events.summary: The Eroshian army takes part in the siege of Aphetto and then marches on Averru, where most are killed.
events.quote: The Eroshians then marched on to the city of Averru , where most of them were killed in the fighting.

events.summary: Karona is killed by the Mirari-sword and her magic returns to the land and to Eroshia.
events.quote: When Karona was killed by the Mirari -sword, her magic returned to the land.

relations.quote: Eroshia is a city-state in Otaria , on the plane of Dominaria .
When Karona was killed by the Mirari -sword, her magic returned to the land.
After receiving human bodies from Akroma shortly before the Rebirth of Karona
